title.narrative: Reduction in discriminatory status prevailing for the FSW, DW, SW, in the country

description.narrative: It is estimated that there are 30,000 50,000 Female Sex Workers (FSW) in the country although a comprehensive survey has not been undertaken so far. One in four households are found to be headed by women, of which more than 50% are widowed. The number of Deserted women (DW) and Single Women (SW) can be estimated as approximately 15 20% of the total female headed households in the country. These FSW, DW and SW live in the country with a high likelihood of being subjected to violence
